# Contributing to QCMLForge

## Pull requests

Create pull requests against the `main` branch. Keep each pull request focused on a
single change and ensure the test suite passes before requesting review.

QCMLForge uses **squash merging** for pull requests. The pull request title becomes
the commit title on `main`, so use a concise, descriptive title. Squashing keeps the
`main` branch history linear and gives each pull request a single, meaningful commit.
